subject: Medford High School MSBA Application Authorization
overview: The committee authorized a formal application to the Massachusetts School Building Authority for Medford High School and reviewed preliminary budget priorities for the 2023 fiscal year.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and the April 4, 2022 minutes with an amendment to correct the attendance record.

items.title: Superintendent's Remarks
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent stated she could not comment on a personnel matter due to confidentiality requirements and reported a slight uptick in COVID-19 transmission at the secondary level.

items.title: MSBA Application Report
items.summary: Approved a motion authorizing the superintendent to submit a statement of interest to the Massachusetts School Building Authority core program to address significant infrastructure and energy efficiency issues at Medford High School. Discussion highlighted that the building currently uses 77% more energy than the national average and would require an estimated $10 million in hazardous material abatement for major renovations.

items.title: FY23 Budget Survey and Update
items.summary: The administration presented an initial FY23 budget preview identifying fixed cost increases, new investments in elementary math curriculum, and committee priorities such as social-emotional wellness and the elimination of fee-based services.

items.title: Presentations of the Public
items.summary: Suspended the rules to begin the public portion of the meeting early, though the chair noted that no residents followed the procedural requirements to be placed on the agenda and personnel matters could not be discussed.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of Barbara Salvatella and Linda Granara Scali before adjourning.
